O'n bir va o'n ikki.intro_en: Hello, friends! I am Kabutar the bird. Today we count after ten: eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen!

twelve.sentence: There are twelve eggs in the box.

tests_en: There are 12 eggs in the box. How many eggs?

extras_en.matn_en: Count to ten fast: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten! Now go on: eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen! Clap for every number!

O'n beshdan o'n yettigacha.intro_en: Hi, children! Kabutar is here again. Let's learn three new numbers: fifteen, sixteen and seventeen!

fifteen.sentence: Fifteen apples are on the table.

tests_en: Sixteen. Which number is it?

extras_en.matn_en: Listen! Six + teen = sixteen. Seven + teen = seventeen. Numbers from thirteen to nineteen end with teen!

Yigirmagacha sanaymiz.intro_en: Hello, my clever friends! Today we count all the way to twenty. Are you ready? Let's go!

eighteen.sentence: There are eighteen children in my class.

nineteen.sentence: Nineteen stars are in the sky.

twenty.sentence: I have twenty fingers and toes.

tests_en: Fingers and toes together. How many?

extras_en.matn_en: Let's sing and count: eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen, sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen, twenty! Now jump up high — Hooray!

Nechta ekan?.intro_en: Hi, friends! Kabutar loves counting. Let's count cats and stars together!

How many?.sentence: How many apples do you have?

twenty stars.sentence: There are twenty stars in the sky.

tests_en: How many stars can you see?

extras_en.matn_en: Kabutar: How many apples? Child: One, two, three… twelve! Twelve apples! Now you ask: How many pencils?

Dushanba, seshanba, chorshanba.intro_en: Good morning, friends! A week has seven days. Today we learn Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday!

Monday.sentence: On Monday I go to school.

Wednesday.action_en: Draw a circle in the air!

extras_en.matn_en: The train is going! The first car is Monday, the second is Tuesday, the third is Wednesday. Choo-choo! Say every car!

Payshanbadan yakshanbagacha.intro_en: Hello again! Kabutar knows four more days. Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday. Let's say them together!

Saturday.sentence: On Saturday I visit my granny.

Sunday.sentence: On Sunday we go to the park.

tests_en: Which day is the last day of the week?

extras_en.matn_en: Let's sing: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday! Seven days — one week! Show one finger for every day.

Bugun qaysi kun?.intro_en: Hi, children! Every morning Kabutar asks: what day is it today? Let's learn to ask and answer!

What day is it today?.sentence: Mum, what day is it today?

Today is Monday..sentence: Today is Monday. I go to school.

tests_en: What day is it today? What does it mean?

extras_en.matn_en: Kabutar: What day is it today? Child: Today is Friday. Kabutar: And tomorrow? Child: Saturday! Now you ask!

Tong, kech va tun.intro_en: Good morning, friends! The day has morning, evening and night. Let's talk about them!

morning.sentence: In the morning I eat breakfast.

evening.sentence: In the evening I read a book.

night.sentence: At night I sleep in my bed.

weekend.sentence: At the weekend I play with friends.

tests_en: The moon and stars are out. Everyone is sleeping. When is it?

extras_en.matn_en: I say, you show! Morning — stretch! Evening — eat! Night — sleep! Weekend — play and jump!

Shifokor va o'qituvchi.intro_en: Hello, friends! People do many jobs. Today we meet a doctor, a teacher, a cook and a farmer!

farmer.sentence: The farmer has cows and hens.

tests_en: Who grows carrots and potatoes?

extras_en.matn_en: Riddle: He makes nice food. Who is he? A cook! She teaches children. Who is she? A teacher! He helps sick people. Who is he? A doctor!

Qahramon kasblar.intro_en: Hi, children! Some jobs are very brave. Let's meet the hero jobs with Kabutar!

pilot.sentence: The pilot flies a big plane.

builder.sentence: The builder makes a new house.

tests_en: Who flies a plane in the sky?

extras_en.matn_en: I say a job, you act! Pilot — fly! Firefighter — spray water! Builder — knock, knock! Police officer — salute!

Kim bo'lmoqchisan?.intro_en: Hello, friends! Kabutar wants to be a pilot. What do you want to be? Let's talk about it!

He is a doctor..sentence: This is my dad. He is a doctor.

She is a teacher..sentence: This is my mum. She is a teacher.

What do you want to be?.sentence: Anvar, what do you want to be?

I want to be a pilot..sentence: I want to be a pilot. I love planes!

tests_en: What do you want to be? What is a good answer?

extras_en.matn_en: Kabutar: What do you want to be? Child: I want to be a doctor. Or a teacher, a pilot, a cook. Now ask your friend!

Kim qayerda ishlaydi?.intro_en: Hi, friends! Where do people work? Let's find out with Kabutar!

hospital.sentence: The doctor works in a hospital.

farm.sentence: The farmer works on a farm.

shop.sentence: I buy bread at the shop.

tests_en: Where does a teacher work?

extras_en.matn_en: Let's match: doctor — hospital. Teacher — school. Farmer — farm. A seller works in a shop.

Mashina va avtobus.intro_en: Beep, beep! Hello, friends! Today we learn about a car, a bus, a taxi and a bike!

car.sentence: My dad has a red car.

bus.sentence: I go to school by bus.

extras_en.matn_en: Let's sing: The wheels on the bus go round and round, round and round! Turn your hands like wheels! At the end: Beep, beep!

Poyezd va samolyot.intro_en: Hello, friends! Some things go on land, some in the sky and some on the water. Let's see!

plane.sentence: The plane flies in the sky.

ship.sentence: A big ship is on the sea.

tests_en: Which big transport goes on the sea?

extras_en.matn_en: On the road — car, bus, train. In the sky — plane. On the water — ship and boat. What flies in the sky? A plane!

Yordam mashinalari.intro_en: Hi, children! Some cars help people. Listen to them: nee-naw, nee-naw!

fire engine.sentence: The fire engine is big and red.

ambulance.sentence: The ambulance goes to the hospital.

helicopter.sentence: The helicopter flies over the house.
helicopter.action_en: Spin your arms like a helicopter!

tests_en: Which car takes a sick person to hospital?

extras_en.matn_en: A firefighter drives a fire engine. A doctor goes in an ambulance. A police officer drives a police car. A pilot flies a helicopter or a plane!

Maktabga qanday borasan?.intro_en: Good morning, friends! How do you go to school? By bus, by car, or do you walk? Let's talk!

How do you go to school?.sentence: Malika, how do you go to school?

I go by bus..sentence: I go by bus with my friend.

I walk..sentence: I walk to school with mum.

tests_en: How do you go to school? Which answer is right?

extras_en.matn_en: Red light — Stop! Don't move! Green light — Go! Walk on the spot! Listen: Go! Go! Stop! Who is right every time?

Kitob va qalam.intro_en: Hello, friends! Soon you go to school. What is in your school bag? Let's look!

school bag.sentence: My book is in my school bag.

extras_en.matn_en: Let's pack the school bag! I say, you put it in: book! Pencil! Pen! Now close your school bag. Ready!

Chizg'ich va qaychi.intro_en: Hi, children! Kabutar has a ruler, crayons, scissors and a notebook. Let's learn these words!

crayons.sentence: I draw a rainbow with crayons.

tests_en: What do we cut paper with?

extras_en.matn_en: Kabutar: What's in your bag? Child: A book, a pencil, a ruler, crayons, scissors, a notebook! Did you find them all?

O'rningdan tur!.intro_en: Hello, class! Kabutar is your teacher today. Listen and do what I say!

Sit down!.sentence: Sit down on your chair, please.

tests_en: The teacher says: Sit down! What do we do?

extras_en.matn_en: Game: If I say «Teacher says», do it! If I don't, don't move! Teacher says: Stand up! … Sit down! — Oops, don't move!

Tingla va qara!.intro_en: Hi, friends! Good pupils listen and look. Let's learn more class words with Kabutar!

Listen!.action_en: Put your hand to your ear!

Be quiet!.sentence: Be quiet! The baby is sleeping.
Be quiet!.action_en: Put a finger on your lips!

tests_en: You want to answer. What does the teacher say?

extras_en.matn_en: Let's play school! Stand up! Look! Listen! Sit down! Open your book! Be quiet! Do you know the answer? Raise your hand!

Suza olasanmi?.intro_en: Hello, friends! Can you swim? Can you fly? Let's ask and answer with Kabutar!

Yes, I can..sentence: Can you jump? Yes, I can.

No, I can't..sentence: Can you fly? No, I can't.

tests_en: Can you fly? What do people say?
Can you swim? You can swim. What do you say?

extras_en.matn_en: Kabutar: Can you swim? Child: Yes, I can. Kabutar: Can you fly? Child: No, I can't! Now you ask Kabutar: Can you jump?

Velosiped va futbol.intro_en: Hi, children! Kabutar loves sports. Let's learn to climb, ride a bike, play football and skate!

ride a bike.sentence: I ride a bike in the park.

tests_en: Ride a bike. Which picture is it?

extras_en.matn_en: I act, you guess and ask! I ride… Can you ride a bike? I kick a ball… Can you play football? Answer: Yes, I can!

Hayvonlar nima qila oladi?.intro_en: Hello, friends! Animals can do many things. What can they do? Let's see!

A bird can fly..sentence: A bird can fly. I can fly too!

A frog can jump..sentence: A frog can jump very high.

A snake can't walk..sentence: A snake can't walk. It has no legs.

tests_en: Which animal can fly?

extras_en.matn_en: Be an animal! A frog can jump — jump! A bird can fly — flap your arms! A fish can swim — swim! A snake can't walk — crawl!

Yordam berasanmi?.intro_en: Hi, friends! Good friends help each other. Let's learn to ask for help and say kind words!

Can you help me?.sentence: My bag is big. Can you help me?

Of course!.sentence: Of course! I can help you.

Well done!.sentence: Well done! You are very clever.

tests_en: Your friend says: Can you help me? What is a good answer?

extras_en.matn_en: Kabutar: Can you help me? Child: Of course! We carry the seeds together. Kabutar: Thank you! Let's play! At the end: Well done!

Do'konga kirdik.intro_en: Hello, friends! Let's play shop! Kabutar is the seller. What do you want?

An apple, please..sentence: An apple, please. A red one!

Here you are..sentence: Here is your apple. Here you are.

tests_en: The seller gives you an apple and says: Here you are. What do you say?

extras_en.matn_en: Seller: Hello! Can I help you? Child: An apple, please. Seller: Here you are. Child: Thank you! Now change roles!

Nechta kerak?.intro_en: Hi, friends! In the shop we say how many we want. Let's buy bananas with Kabutar!

How many bananas?.sentence: How many bananas do you want?

tests_en: Someone says Thank you! What is the answer?

extras_en.matn_en: Seller: How many bananas? Child: Five bananas, please. Seller: One, two, three, four, five. Here you are. Child: Thank you! Seller: You're welcome!

Sabzavot rastasi.intro_en: Hello, friends! Now we are at the vegetable stall. Look at the carrots, tomatoes, potatoes and eggs!

eggs.sentence: I eat eggs in the morning.

tests_en: Which long orange vegetable does a rabbit like?

extras_en.matn_en: Mum's list: three carrots, two tomatoes, four potatoes, ten eggs. Ask the seller: Three carrots, please! We have it all!

Savat va pul.intro_en: Hi, friends! We need a basket and money for the shop. Let's go shopping!

basket.sentence: Put the apples in the basket.

tests_en: Where do we put the things we buy?

extras_en.matn_en: Seller: Hello! Can I help you? Child: Two tomatoes, please. Seller: Here you are. Child: Thank you! Here is the money. Seller: Goodbye, see you! Now you are the seller!

Ismim va yoshim.intro_en: Hello, friends! My name is Kabutar. What is your name? How old are you? Let's talk!

I am six..sentence: I am six. I like school.

I am seven..sentence: I am seven. I am big!

tests_en: How old are you? What does it mean?

extras_en.matn_en: Kabutar: Hello! What's your name? Child: My name is… Kabutar: How old are you? Child: I am six. Or: I am seven.

Qayerda yashayman.intro_en: Hi, children! Kabutar lives in a big tree. Where do you live? Let's learn to say it!

I live in Samarkand..sentence: I live in Samarkand with my family.

extras_en.matn_en: Kabutar: Where do you live? Child: I live in Samarkand. Or: I live in Tashkent. Then say: I am from Uzbekistan!

Men yaxshi ko'raman.intro_en: Hello, friends! Kabutar likes seeds and songs. What do you like? Let's tell each other!

I like football..sentence: I like football. It is fun!

My favourite food is plov..sentence: Yummy! My favourite food is plov.

My favourite colour is green..sentence: My favourite colour is green. I like trees.

tests_en: My favourite food is plov. Which picture is it?

extras_en.matn_en: Ask your friends: What do you like? Friend: I like football. I like cake. Then say: My favourite colour is… Who likes what?

Bu — men!.intro_en: Hi, friends! This is the last lesson. Let's tell our friends about us!

I have a sister..sentence: I have a sister. Her name is Malika.

I have a pet..sentence: I have a pet. It is a cat.

Nice to meet you!.sentence: Hello, Anvar! Nice to meet you!

This is me!.sentence: Look at my picture. This is me!

tests_en: You meet a new friend. What do you say?

extras_en.matn_en: Go on stage and say: Hello! This is me! My name is… I am six. I live in Samarkand. I have a sister. I can swim. I like football. Nice to meet you!

scenarios.name: Do'konda: tuxum sanaymiz
scenarios.goal: Bola do'konda nechta narsa kerakligini 11–20 sonlari bilan aytadi va sanaydi
scenarios.intro: Bugun do'konga boramiz va tuxum sanaymiz.
scenarios.intro_en: Today we go to the shop and count eggs. Let's count together!

scene.image_prompt: A small friendly shop with egg boxes on a counter, a smiling seller and a child counting eggs, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

dialog.say: Hello! Can I have some eggs, please?
Hello! How many eggs?
Twelve eggs, please.
Let's count! One, two, three… twelve!
dialog.uz: keling, sanaymiz! bir, ikki, uch… o'n ikki!

dialog.say: And fifteen apples, please.
Here you are. Twelve eggs and fifteen apples.
dialog.uz: mana, oling. o'n ikkita tuxum va o'n beshta olma

dialog.say: Thank you! Goodbye!

questions.q_en: How many eggs does the child want?

questions.q: Sotuvchi nechta degan savolni qanday beradi?
questions.q_en: The seller asks about the number. What does the seller say?

scenarios.name: Haftani rejalashtiramiz
scenarios.goal: Bola oila a'zosi bilan hafta kunlari va dam olish rejasi haqida gaplashadi
scenarios.intro_en: Let's plan the week with Mum. What do we do every day?

scene.image_prompt: A mother and child at a kitchen table looking at a big colorful weekly calendar on the wall, morning light, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

dialog.say: Good morning, Mum! What day is it today?
dialog.uz: xayrli tong, oyi! bugun qaysi kun?

dialog.say: Good morning! Today is Monday.
What do I do on Monday?
On Monday you go to school by bus.
And on Saturday?
On Saturday we visit Granny.
Hooray! And on Sunday we play at the weekend!
dialog.uz: hurra! yakshanba dam olish kunida o'ynaymiz!

questions.q_en: What do they do on Saturday?

scenarios.name: Shifokor qabulida
scenarios.goal: Bola shifokor bilan salomlashadi, o'zini tanishtiradi va minnatdorchilik bildiradi
scenarios.intro_en: Today we visit the doctor at the hospital. The doctor is very kind!

scene.image_prompt: A bright friendly doctor's room in a hospital, a smiling doctor with a stethoscope and a child sitting on a chair, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

dialog.say: Hello! Come in, please. What's your name?
Hello! My name is Anvar.
How old are you, Anvar?
I am six.
Open your mouth, please. Good! You are fine.
Thank you, doctor! I want to be a doctor too.
dialog.uz: rahmat, shifokor! men ham shifokor bo'lmoqchiman

dialog.say: Well done! Goodbye, see you!

questions.q_en: What does Anvar want to be?
options: 🧑‍⚕️ I want to be a doctor.
🧑‍✈️ I want to be a pilot.
🧑‍🌾 I want to be a farmer.
🧑‍🍳 I want to be a cook.
questions.why: Barakalla! [en]I want to be a doctor.[/en]
questions.why_en: Well done! He wants to be a doctor.

scenarios.name: Avtobusda sayohat
scenarios.goal: Bola avtobusda odob bilan salomlashadi, yo'nalishni so'raydi va xavfsizlik qoidasini aytadi
scenarios.intro_en: We go to the park by bus with Granny. Let's get on the bus!

scene.image_prompt: A child and grandmother getting on a colorful city bus at a bus stop, a friendly bus driver waving, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

dialog.say: Hello! Is this bus to the park?
Yes, it is. Come in, please!
Thank you! Look, Granny! A fire engine!
dialog.uz: rahmat! qarang, buvi! o't o'chirish mashinasi!

dialog.say: Sit down, please. We go now.
How many stops to the park?
Three stops. Here is the park. Stop!
Thank you! Goodbye, see you!

questions.q_en: The driver wants you to sit. What does he say?

scenarios.name: Maktabdagi birinchi kun
scenarios.goal: Bola yangi o'qituvchi bilan tanishadi va sinf buyruqlarini bajaradi
scenarios.intro_en: Today is the first day at school! Let's meet our new teacher.

scene.image_prompt: A cheerful classroom on the first day of school, a kind teacher greeting a child with a school bag, desks and books, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

dialog.say: Good morning! I am your teacher. What's your name?
dialog.uz: xayrli tong! men o'qituvchingman. isming nima?

dialog.say: Good morning! My name is Malika.
Nice to meet you, Malika! Sit down, please.
Thank you! Can I open my book?
Yes. Take a pencil and a notebook too.
dialog.uz: ha. qalam va daftarni ham ol

dialog.say: Who knows the answer? Raise your hand!
Me! I know!
Well done, Malika!

questions.q: O'qituvchi o'tirishni so'radi. U nima dedi?
questions.q_en: The teacher wants Malika to sit. What does she say?
You want to answer. What do you do?

scenarios.name: Sport kuni
scenarios.goal: Bola do'stidan nima qila olishini so'raydi, birga o'ynashni taklif qiladi va maqtaydi
scenarios.intro_en: It's sports day! What can you do? Let's run, jump and play!

scene.image_prompt: A sunny sports day on a school playground, children running, jumping and kicking a football, colorful flags, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

dialog.say: Hi! Can you play football?
Yes, I can! Can you skate?
dialog.uz: ha, o'ynay olaman! sen konkida ucha olasanmi?

dialog.say: No, I can't. But I can jump high!
dialog.uz: yo'q, ucha olmayman. lekin baland sakray olaman!

dialog.say: Let's play football!
Oh no! My shoe! Can you help me?
dialog.uz: voy! oyoq kiyimim! yordam bera olasanmi?

dialog.say: Of course! Here you are.
Thank you! You are a good friend.
Goal! Hooray! Well done!

questions.q: Do'stingiz Can you help me? desa, nima deysiz?
questions.q_en: Your friend says: Can you help me? What do you say?

scenarios.name: Ro'yxat bilan bozorga
scenarios.goal: Bola ro'yxat bo'yicha sabzavot so'raydi, nechta kerakligini aytadi va pul to'laydi
scenarios.intro_en: Mum gives us a shopping list. Let's buy carrots, tomatoes and eggs!

scene.image_prompt: A colorful market vegetable stall with carrots, tomatoes, potatoes and eggs, a child holding a shopping list and a basket, a friendly seller, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

dialog.say: Hello! Can I help you?
Hello! Five carrots, please.
Here you are. Anything else?
Yes. Six tomatoes and twelve eggs, please.
dialog.uz: ha. oltita pomidor va o'n ikkita tuxum, iltimos

dialog.say: Put them in your basket. Here you are.
Here is the money. Thank you!
You're welcome. Goodbye, see you!

questions.q_en: How many carrots does the child want?
Where do we put the things we buy?

questions.q: Rahmat!ga sotuvchi nima deb javob berdi?
questions.q_en: The child says Thank you! What does the seller say?

scenarios.name: Telefonda yangi do'st
scenarios.name_en: A phone call with a new friend
scenarios.goal: Bola telefonda o'zini tanishtiradi: ismi, yoshi, qayerda yashashi va nimani yaxshi ko'rishi
scenarios.intro_en: Ring, ring! Let's call a new friend and tell about us!

scene.image_prompt: Two happy children talking on phones in their homes, split scene with a speech bubble feeling, cozy rooms, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

dialog.say: Hello! This is Sam. What's your name?
Hello, Sam! My name is Malika. Nice to meet you!
dialog.uz: salom, Sem! ismim Malika. tanishganimdan xursandman!

dialog.say: Nice to meet you too! How old are you?
I am seven. Where do you live?
dialog.uz: men yetti yoshdaman. sen qayerda yashaysan?

dialog.say: I live in London. And you?
I live in Samarkand. I am from Uzbekistan.
What do you like?
I like football. My favourite food is plov!
dialog.uz: futbolni yaxshi ko'raman. sevimli taomim palov!

questions.q: Yangi do'st bilan tanishganda nima deysiz?
questions.q_en: You meet a new friend. What do you say?
